claims.claim: 纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例冠心病患者的 Meta 分析显示，速效救心丸较对照治疗改善心电图结果（RR 1.32，95%CI 1.26 至 1.38，P<0.001）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease. … Pooled analysis indicated significant benefits of suxiao jiuxin pill on ECG outcomes (RR 1.32; 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 冠心病总体人群，未做 PCI 术后亚组分析；该结果为总体人群的间接证据。
claims.uncertainty: 按 GRADE 为低确定性：纳入研究多因缺乏双盲设计获低 Jadad 评分，异质性 I²=62.3%。

claims.claim: 该 Meta 分析纳入的研究多数因缺乏双盲设计获低 Jadad 评分，且未分析心血管死亡结局。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design … In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.
claims.applicability: 适用于对该 Meta 分析证据等级的评估。
claims.uncertainty: 方法学质量低，终点为心电图与血脂等替代终点。

claims.claim: 该 Meta 分析报告不良反应发生率在速效救心丸组与对照组之间无显著差异（RR 1.12，95%CI 0.50 至 2.51，P=0.785），最常见为轻度头痛、头晕与面部潮红。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 冠心病总体人群；未报告与抗血小板治疗合用的出血相关终点。
claims.uncertainty: 14 项研究报告不良反应，发生率为被动报告，分母与监测强度不一。

claims.claim: 纳入 174 例对长效硝酸酯不良反应不耐受的慢性冠脉综合征患者的多中心随机双盲安慰剂对照试验显示，4 周后速效救心丸组 SAQ 总分改善 ≥20 分者占 60.9%，安慰剂组为 39.1%（OR 2.43，95%CI 1.32 至 4.47，P=0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses … for a duration of 4 weeks … 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1% (OR = 2.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004) of patients in the placebo group achieved the same level of improvement
claims.applicability: 慢性冠脉综合征（稳定型）人群，非 PCI 术后急性场景；结果为冠心病总体人群证据。
claims.uncertainty: 随访仅 4 周，样本量小，未报告主要心血管事件终点。

claims.claim: 该试验治疗期间禁止患者接受 PCI 或 CABG 血运重建，背景治疗以阿司匹林（73.6%）、他汀（71.3%）、β 受体阻滞剂（54.0%）为主。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: participants were prohibited from receiving any other anti-anginal therapy-related concomitant medications, Traditional Chinese Medicine therapies (acupuncture, moxibustion, Tuina, or cupping), as well as revascularization therapies (such as coronary artery bypass graft or percutaneous coronary intervention) … Antianginal therapies were commonly prescribed aspirin (73.6%), statin (71.3%), and β-Blockers (54.0%)
claims.applicability: 说明该人群为未在试验期接受血运重建的稳定冠心病患者，而非 PCI 围术期人群。
claims.uncertainty: 是否包含既往 PCI 术后患者未在纳入/排除标准中显式说明。

claims.claim: 该慢性冠脉综合征试验中无参与者报告不良反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: No participants reported experiencing adverse effects.
claims.applicability: 4 周短期、174 例的观察范围；不构成与抗血小板长期合用的出血安全性证据。
claims.uncertainty: 样本量小、疗程短，未系统采集出血终点。

claims.claim: 药理研究显示速效救心丸通过激活 eNOS-NO 通路诱导冠状动脉舒张，其成分冰片呈内皮非依赖性血管舒张。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill attenuates acute myocardial ischemia via regulation of coronary artery tone
claims.supportQuote: SJP induced coronary artery relaxation via activation of the eNOS-NO pathway … borneol induced endothelium-independent vasorelaxation of the coronary artery
claims.applicability: 离体血管与动物实验，机制层面证据，不构成临床效应量。
claims.uncertainty: 为作用方向与通路证据，不能推出临床结局改善幅度。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸在大鼠心肌缺血再灌注损伤模型中缩小梗死面积、减少心肌凋亡并改善左室功能。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill alleviates myocardial ischemia–reperfusion injury through the ALKBH5/GSK3β/mTOR pathway
claims.supportQuote: SJP significantly mitigated MIRI in rats, reducing infarct size and myocardial apoptosis, and improving left ventricular function.
claims.applicability: 动物模型再灌注损伤保护，机制层面；该文自述其先前临床研究证实速效救心丸减轻早期血运重建 ACS 患者的 MACE。
claims.uncertainty: 动物模型外推至临床的效应量未知。

claims.claim: 一项 6 个月速效救心丸治疗与 ACS 患者 PCI 后 1 年主要不良心血管事件（MACE）显著下降相关（p<0.05，OR 1.916），并伴随左室射血分数与症状改善。
claims.sourceTitle: Exploring the Complementary Role of Traditional Chinese Medicine in Enhancing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention Outcomes: Mechanisms, Benefits, and Future Research Directions
claims.supportQuote: a 6-month treatment with Suxiao Jiuxin Pills (comprising Chuanxiong Rhizoma and borneol) in ACS patients post-PCI was associated with a significant reduction in 1-year MACEs (p < 0.05, odds ratio 1.916), alongside improvements in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) and symptoms.
claims.applicability: 该系统综述转述的 Shen 2020 试验（ACS 早期 PCI 人群）的 MACE 结果；为术后人群直接证据的二级转述。
claims.uncertainty: 效应量来自单一 200 例试验，OR 1.916 的置信区间未在本综述中列明；直接性受限于 ACS 早期 PCI 围术期连续用药人群。

claims.claim: 该系统综述纳入 20 项 RCT，报告丹红注射液、通心络胶囊等中成药在 PCI 期间缓解心绞痛、改善心功能、减少无复流/慢血流并抑制支架内再狭窄。
claims.sourceTitle: Exploring the Complementary Role of Traditional Chinese Medicine in Enhancing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention Outcomes: Mechanisms, Benefits, and Future Research Directions
claims.supportQuote: A review of 20 RCTs showed that TCM plays multiple roles in CAD treatment during PCI. Specific interventions such as Danhong Injection, Tongxinluo Capsule, and Shenzhu Guanxin Granule were found to alleviate angina symptoms, restore cardiac function, reduce cardiac biomarkers, prevent no-reflow/slow-flow phenomena, inhibit in-stent restenosis, and improve prognosis while reducing complications.
claims.applicability: 中成药用于 PCI 的总体研究版图；速效救心丸并非该领域研究最多的药物。
claims.uncertainty: 综述作者自述 Future high-quality studies are needed to further validate these findings；纳入 RCT 仅要求 ≥100 例。

claims.claim: 纳入 55 项 RCT（改良 Jadad 评分 >4）、共 36,261 例患者的系统综述报告，速效救心丸与清心解郁胶囊在降低心血管事件方面具有显著优势（p<0.05）。
claims.sourceTitle: Traditional Chinese medicine for cardiovascular disease: efficacy and safety
claims.supportQuote: we systematically reviewed 55 published RCTs (modified Jadad scores > 4) in the past 20 years, involving a total of 36,261 patients … Qingxin jieyu capsule and Suxiaojiuxin pills demonstrated significant advantages in reducing cardiovascular (CV) events ( p < 0.05).
claims.applicability: 冠心病总体人群；心血管事件为部分试验报告的硬终点。
claims.uncertainty: 综述性转述，未给出速效救心丸单独的点估计与置信区间。

claims.claim: 针对 ACS 早期 PCI 患者（n=200，平均年龄 61.2 岁）的多中心 RCT 中，速效救心丸组 MACE 发生率低于安慰剂组（p<0.05）。
claims.sourceTitle: Traditional Chinese medicine for cardiovascular disease: efficacy and safety
claims.supportQuote: A multicenter RCT investigated the safety and efficacy of Suxiaojiuxin pills, the most frequently used drug in the cardiovascular acute phase in China, in patients with ACS with early PCI ( n = 200, mean age = 61.2 years). The occurrence of MACE in Suxiaojiuxin Pills group was lower than that in placebo group ( p < 0.05).
claims.applicability: ACS 早期 PCI 人群的直接证据（二级转述 Shen 2020）。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述对单一试验的转述；MACE 为次要/探索性观察，未给出分项事件率。

claims.claim: 突发胸痛伴出汗、恶心、头晕或气短者可能为心肌梗死，应立即呼叫急救（英国为 999，中国为 120）并送医。
claims.supportQuote: you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 面向未分化急性胸痛的公共分诊指导；急救号码按英国原文为 999，中国情境为 120。
claims.uncertainty: 来源为英国 NHS 公共页，非本品说明书；用于支撑「不得以用药替代急救评估」的处置边界。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸用于 ACS 早期 PCI 患者的直接随机对照证据来自一项 200 例多中心双盲安慰剂对照试验，两项彼此独立的系统综述均转述其 1 年 MACE 下降（p<0.05）。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Exploring the Complementary Role of Traditional Chinese Medicine in Enhancing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention Outcomes
supportingSources.supportQuote: a 6-month treatment with Suxiao Jiuxin Pills (comprising Chuanxiong Rhizoma and borneol) in ACS patients post-PCI was associated with a significant reduction in 1-year MACEs (p < 0.05, odds ratio 1.916), alongside improvements in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) and symptoms.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Traditional Chinese medicine for cardiovascular disease: efficacy and safety
supportingSources.supportQuote: A multicenter RCT investigated the safety and efficacy of Suxiaojiuxin pills … in patients with ACS with early PCI ( n = 200, mean age = 61.2 years). The occurrence of MACE in Suxiaojiuxin Pills group was lower than that in placebo group ( p < 0.05).

claims.applicability: ACS 早期 PCI 人群；两项综述的结论同源于 Shen 2020 一项试验，不构成独立重复。
claims.uncertainty: 直接性限于 ACS 早期 PCI 围术期/术后连续用药人群；MACE 点估计（OR 1.916）仅见于其中一篇综述。

claims.claim: 两项综述转述的 MACE 下降均指向 Shen 2020 同一项 200 例试验，因此就「速效救心丸降低 ACS 早期 PCI 患者 MACE」这一结论而言，现有证据为单一试验的转述，而非两项独立研究的重复验证。
claims.method: CLM-009（PMC12260233）与 CLM-012（PMC11649660）所引用的 MACE 结果均出自 Shen Z 2020 试验（n=200，ChiCTR-TRC-13003053）；两份综述作者与期刊不同，但底层数据源为同一项试验，故合并计数为 1 项试验而非 2 项独立证据。
claims.assumptions: 两份综述对 MACE 的转述均指向同一原始试验（两者摘要/正文均仅引用 Shen Z 2020 作为速效救心丸 PCI 后 MACE 的来源）。
claims.sensitivity: 若存在其他未在综述中列出的、以 MACE 为终点的速效救心丸 PCI 后独立试验，则该计数将低估；但本次检索未发现此类试验。
claims.applicability: 用于防止把同一试验的多次转述误读为重复验证。
claims.uncertainty: 计数以本次检索到的综述转述为准。
